intro.heading: The Art of Bespoke
intro.body: Every stitch tells a story of heritage. For decades, Yaseen Tailor has crafted suits, sherwanis, and kurta-pajamas that stand the test of time, earning a legacy of client retention and absolute trust.

master.heading: Master Tailor
master.body1: With a lifetime dedicated to the sartorial arts, Master Tailor Faisal Khan brings an uncompromising eye for detail to every garment.
master.body2: Located in the heart of Adalat Bazar, Patiala, his hands have shaped the wardrobes of generations.

global.heading: Global Reach
global.body: Distance is no barrier to excellence. We offer over-the-phone measurement consultations for our international clientele, ensuring a perfect fit anywhere in the world.
